name: Premium Quality Ayatul Kursi Metal Bracelet
description:
Our cuffs are fully adjustable and they are one size fits all. They can be stretched out and squeezed in to fit any size with no creases or bends.

Regarded as the most powerful verse in the Qur'an, Ayatul Kursi is known to provide protection and safety. Bringing this beautiful and sentimental verse to our jewelry has proven to be an all-time favorite here at Nominal. We are proud to now introduce it into our cuff collection. Engraved entirely on the front and continuing onto the back to offer a beautifully intricate aesthetic, this cuff has become one of our most detailed designs of all time.
